classification: Author mathematical and implementation review; not independent review
arithmetic_checks: Expansion includes all ordered pairs; off-diagonal coefficient is 2.
Diagonal bound holds termwise and uses exactly N integer indices.
Squarefree union bound over all square divisors is conservative; dyadic threshold 2048 exceeds sufficient 1536.
Absolute majorant lower bound does not imply signed S divergence.
Growing index blocks run J to 2J-1, not a fixed number of doublings.
Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz keeps the varying actual residual and assumes both open averaged hypotheses.
No mean or finite interval is extrapolated; no new numerator was computed.
Finite sums need no physical cutoff. Doubled sieve and direct quadratic expansion are independent checks.
geometry_checks: Source handout actually contains no exterior similarity definition; derived formula is not attributed to it.
Separate inversions and two successive orders distinguished.
Externally versus internally tangent interpretation disclosed.
Inversion centres, missing limiting circle points and equal-radius degeneracy retained.
Zero locations mapped; unchanged zeta is not asserted invariant under inversion.
Polynomial control preserves reflection/conjugation only, not zeta arithmetic.
Matched finite height counts, multiplicity and reflected off-line partners retained.
Power-product nonnegativity is exact; its vanishing is an unproved target.
The 0/1 variant interpretations are explicit rather than assumed unique.
what_had_to_change: Retain signed Mobius pair correlations in the averaged cost. Replace circle-count imbalance by an actual off-line displacement detector, while leaving its arithmetic vanishing unproved.
obstruction: No compatible averaged numerator and signed-cost bounds; geometry alone cannot distinguish the symmetric off-line control.
bound_or_object: Only the absolute-product cost majorant and the geometry-only count/infinity inference fail; no failure of the actual signed cost, approximation family, RH, or all geometric routes.
document_review: HTML source and embedded plot reviewed; plot visually inspected. Browser URL policy blocked local-file browser preview; requested app file preview instead.
